description_en: Scales up or scales down a Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
description_zh: 对湖仓版集群进行升降配
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-db-cluster --db-cluster-id amv-bp1r053byu48p0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBCluster

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the cluster ID of a Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
parameters.help_zh:
湖仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口查看湖仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html operation to query the region ID of a specified Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html接口查看指定湖仓版集群的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The storage reserved resources. Valid values: 0 ACU to 2064 ACU, in increments of 24. 1 ACU is approximately equivalent to 1 core and 4 GB of memory.
Include the unit when you specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
存储预留资源。取值范围：0ACU～2064ACU，步长：24。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB。
参数填写时，需要带单位
parameters.name: storage_resource

parameters.help_en:
The compute reserved resources. Valid values: 0 ACU to 4096 ACU, in increments of 16. 1 ACU is approximately equivalent to 1 core and 4 GB of memory.
Include the unit when you specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
计算预留资源。取值范围：0ACU～4096ACU，步长：16。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB。
参数填写时，需要带单位
parameters.name: compute_resource

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allocate all compute reserved resources to the default resource group (user_default). Valid values:
true (default): All compute reserved resources are allocated to the default resource group.
false: Not all compute reserved resources are allocated to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
计算预留资源是否全部分配给默认资源组（user_default），取值说明：
true（默认值）：是
false：否
parameters.name: enable_default_resource_pool

parameters.help_en:
The product form. Valid values:
IntegrationForm: integrated form.
LegacyForm: Data Lakehouse Edition
parameters.help_zh:
产品形态。取值为：
IntegrationForm：融合形态。
LegacyForm：湖仓版
parameters.name: product_form

parameters.help_en:
The node specifications of storage reserved resources. Valid values: 8ACU, 12ACU, and 16ACU.
Include the unit when you specify this parameter. This parameter is required only when ProductForm is set to IntegrationForm
parameters.help_zh:
存储预留资源节点规格，支持8ACU，12ACU，16ACU
参数填写时，需要带单位，仅ProductForm取值为IntegrationForm时，填写该参数
parameters.name: reserved_node_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of reserved nodes. 
Enterprise Edition: The default value is 3. The value increases in increments of 3.
Basic Edition: The default value is 1.
This parameter is required only when ProductForm is set to IntegrationForm
parameters.help_zh:
预留节点数。 
企业版默认为3节点，步长为3。
基础版默认为1节点。
仅ProductForm取值为IntegrationForm时，填写该参数
parameters.name: reserved_node_count

DBClusterId.description_en: The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
